verdict.rationale: Relay's first-party docs say it captures receipts, categorizes expenses and automatically syncs everything to accounting software. They also say it syncs detailed transaction data directly into QuickBooks Online and Xero, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: setup or sync-behavior documentation (frequency, field mapping, two-way sync), coverage of accounting packages beyond QBO/Xero, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync works as claimed.
